title.zh: 大多伦多地区
title.en: GTA

title.zh: 多伦多市长选战进入最后一周，民调胶着
title.en: Toronto mayor's race enters final week with polls neck and neck

summary.en: With the vote on October 26, new polls disagree on who leads Toronto's mayoral race. A Mainstreet survey has challenger Brad Bradford at 48.9 per cent to Mayor Olivia Chow's 47.5, while a Nanos poll for CP24 and CTV shows Chow's lead shrinking to within the margin of error. Chow is pitching Scarborough transit; Bradford is defending his plan for a public water utility.
summary.zh: 多伦多市长选举10月26日投票，最新民调结果不一。Mainstreet民调显示挑战者布拉德福德以48.9%略领先现任市长邹至蕙的47.5%；Nanos为CP24和CTV所做的民调则显示邹至蕙的领先优势已缩小到误差范围内。邹至蕙主打士嘉堡交通，布拉德福德则为其公共水务公司方案辩护。

title.zh: 安省市政选举10月26日投票，多伦多提前投票人数大增
title.en: Ontario votes October 26; Toronto advance turnout jumps 72%

summary.en: Ontario's municipal elections are on Monday, October 26, with Toronto polls open from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. More than 222,000 Torontonians voted in advance polls, up nearly 72 per cent from the 2023 byelection. Mississauga's Carolyn Parrish and Brampton's Patrick Brown are both seeking re-election; check your city's website for voting locations.
summary.zh: 安省市政选举将于10月26日周一举行，多伦多投票站开放时间为上午10点至晚上8点。多伦多提前投票人数超过22.2万，比2023年补选增加近72%。密西沙加市长帕里什和布兰普顿市长布朗都在寻求连任，投票地点请查看所在城市官网。

title.zh: 安省签约冬季从美国进口电力，此前福特曾威胁断供
title.en: Ontario signs winter deal to import U.S. power after Ford's export threat

summary.en: Ontario has signed a 600-megawatt contract to import electricity from New York starting November 1, to cover winter shortfalls while the Pickering nuclear plant is being refurbished. The price wasn't disclosed. Critics say the power comes from fossil-fuel plants and clashes with Premier Doug Ford's recent threat to cut power exports to the U.S.
summary.zh: 安省签署一份600兆瓦的合同，从11月1日起从纽约州进口电力，以弥补皮克林核电站翻修期间的冬季电力缺口，价格未公开。批评者指出这些电力来自化石燃料电厂，而且与省长福特不久前威胁切断对美电力出口的说法相矛盾。

title.zh: 多伦多租户面临出租楼拆除潮
title.en: Toronto tenants face a wave of rental building demolitions

summary.en: Toronto council has approved 117 applications to demolish rental buildings in the past five years, covering 5,148 rental units that must be replaced, according to city data released Monday. Tenant advocates say displaced renters often struggle to find homes they can afford and are urging councillors to strengthen protections.
summary.zh: 市政府周一公布的数据显示，过去五年多伦多市议会共批准了117宗出租楼拆除申请，涉及5148套需要重建替换的出租单位。租户权益人士表示，被迫搬离的租户往往很难找到负担得起的住房，呼吁市议员加强保护措施。

title.zh: 皮尔逊机场塔台因冒烟疏散，航班延误后已恢复
title.en: Smoke report empties Pearson apron tower, delaying flights overnight

summary.en: Reports of smoke forced the evacuation of Pearson airport's apron management tower, which guides planes at the gates, late Tuesday night, causing flight delays. NAV Canada said its air traffic control tower was not affected. By 6 a.m. Wednesday, Pearson said operations were back to normal, but travellers should check their flight status with their airline.
summary.zh: 周二深夜，皮尔逊机场负责引导飞机进出登机口的停机坪管理塔台因有冒烟报告而疏散，导致航班延误。加拿大航空导航公司表示其空管塔台未受影响。机场周三早上6点表示运营已恢复正常，但旅客仍应向航空公司确认航班状态。

title.zh: 列治文山清晨大火吞没两栋房屋，一名69岁男子死亡
title.en: Man, 69, dies in Richmond Hill fire that engulfed two homes

summary.en: A 69-year-old man died after a fire broke out around 3 a.m. Wednesday near Bayview and Crosby avenues in Richmond Hill. Two semi-detached homes and three cars in a shared driveway were in flames when crews arrived, and burning vehicles blocked entrances. One man was rescued through a basement window; the Ontario Fire Marshal is investigating.
summary.zh: 周三凌晨3点左右，列治文山贝维尤大道与克罗斯比大道附近发生火灾，一名69岁男子死亡。消防员到场时，两栋半独立屋和车道上的三辆车都已起火，燃烧的车辆堵住了房屋入口。一名男子从地下室窗户获救，安省消防局长办公室正在调查起火原因。

title.zh: 流感和新冠疫苗10月26日起向所有安省居民开放
title.en: Flu and COVID shots open to everyone in Ontario from October 26

summary.en: Free flu and COVID-19 vaccines become available to everyone in Ontario aged six months and up starting Monday, October 26, at pharmacies, doctors' offices and public health clinics. Until then, shots are limited to high-risk groups. Peel Public Health opened clinics for priority groups at 7120 Hurontario St. in Mississauga on October 21.
summary.zh: 从10月26日周一起，安省所有6个月以上居民都可在药房、诊所和公共卫生诊所免费接种流感和新冠疫苗，在此之前仅限高风险人群。皮尔区公共卫生局已于10月21日在密西沙加Hurontario街7120号开设诊所，为优先人群接种。

title.zh: 安省将允许非处方助听器上市销售
title.en: Ontario moves to allow over-the-counter hearing aids

summary.en: The Ford government is changing the law so adults with mild to moderate hearing loss can buy Health Canada-approved hearing aids without a prescription. That would let makers switch on hearing-aid features already built into some earbuds sold in Ontario. Prescribed hearing aids will still be funded through the Assistive Devices Program; no start date has been set.
summary.zh: 福特政府正在修改法律，让轻度至中度听力损失的成年人无需处方即可购买经加拿大卫生部批准的助听器，届时部分耳机内置的助听功能也可在安省开通。处方助听器仍由辅助器具计划资助，新规生效日期尚未确定。

title.zh: 布鲁尔西街自行车道拆除抗议持续，已有4人被捕
title.en: Fourth arrest as Bloor West bike lane removal protests continue

summary.en: Toronto police have now arrested four people protesting the province's removal of bike lanes on a 1.2-kilometre stretch of Bloor Street West in Etobicoke, on charges including mischief and obstructing police. The work continues under police protection and should finish in November. The province says it will ease congestion; critics say it makes cycling less safe.
summary.zh: 省政府拆除埃托比科克布鲁尔西街1.2公里自行车道引发抗议，多伦多警方至今已逮捕4人，罪名包括恶作剧和妨碍警务。工程在警方保护下继续进行，预计11月完工。省府称此举可缓解拥堵，批评者则认为会让骑车更不安全。

title.zh: 皮尔警方破获暴力劫车团伙：10人被捕、128项指控
title.en: Peel police lay 128 charges against violent carjacking ring

summary.en: Peel police have arrested 10 people, including two 17-year-olds, and laid 128 charges against a network tied to 21 carjackings and thefts of high-end vehicles across the GTA, some at knife- or gunpoint. Officers recovered 15 stolen vehicles worth about $1.4 million. Chief Nishan Duraiappah said many of the accused will likely be released on bail again.
summary.zh: 皮尔区警方逮捕10人（包括两名17岁少年），提出128项指控，该团伙涉及大多伦多地区21起劫车和盗窃高档车案件，部分案件中持刀或持枪。警方追回15辆被盗车辆，价值约140万加元。警察局长杜赖亚皮表示，许多被告很可能再次获得保释。

title.zh: 多伦多市中心枪击致一男子重伤，两人被捕
title.en: Two arrested after man seriously hurt in downtown Toronto shooting

summary.en: A man in his 50s was shot in the stomach near Sherbourne and Wellesley streets just before 1 a.m. Tuesday and is in hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries. Toronto police arrested two men, aged 22 and 20, and recovered two loaded guns at the scene. Both face aggravated assault and firearm charges.
summary.zh: 周二凌晨1点前，一名50多岁男子在舍伯恩街与威尔斯利街附近腹部中枪，送院后伤势严重但无生命危险。多伦多警方逮捕了两名分别为22岁和20岁的男子，并在现场缴获两支上膛枪支。两人面临严重伤害和枪支相关指控。

title.zh: 布兰普顿高层公寓起火，一人危重
title.en: One person critically hurt in Brampton high-rise fire

summary.en: A fire in a high-rise apartment building near Queen and Beech streets in Brampton on Monday afternoon left one person critically injured. The building was evacuated and residents were later allowed back in, and nearby roads reopened by about 6:30 p.m. The cause of the fire is not yet known.
summary.zh: 周一下午，布兰普顿Queen街与Beech街附近一栋高层公寓起火，一人受重伤情况危急。大楼一度疏散，之后居民获准返回，附近道路约在晚上6点半重新开放。起火原因尚不清楚。

title.zh: 前蓝鸟球员夫妇被控诈骗青少年棒球学费6万元
title.en: Former Blue Jay and wife charged in $60K youth baseball fraud

summary.en: Durham police have charged former Blue Jays player Richard Butler, 53, and his wife Michelle, 52, with fraud over an Ontario youth baseball program. Police say families paid about $60,000 in fees for the Ontario Devil Rays' 2025-26 training season, but the money was moved to the couple's accounts and the training never happened. Police believe there may be more victims.
summary.zh: 达勒姆警方指控前蓝鸟球员理查德·巴特勒（53岁）和妻子米歇尔（52岁）涉嫌诈骗。警方称，多个家庭为安省Devil Rays青少年棒球队2025至26年度训练缴纳了约6万加元，但这笔钱被转入两人账户，训练从未进行。警方认为可能还有其他受害者。

title.zh: 三名加军成员涉多伦多加密货币绑架案被控
title.en: Three soldiers among seven charged in Toronto crypto kidnapping

summary.en: Toronto police have charged seven men, three of them Canadian Armed Forces members, with 82 offences over the July abduction of a crypto exchange owner near Finch and Bayview. Police seized guns with 3D-printed parts and about 2,700 rounds of ammunition, most of it military ammunition never reported stolen. National Defence has opened its own investigation.
summary.zh: 多伦多警方就7月在芬奇大道与贝维尤大道附近绑架一名加密货币交易所老板一案，指控7名男子共82项罪名，其中3人是加拿大军人。警方缴获含3D打印部件的枪支和约2700发子弹，大部分是从未报失的军用弹药。国防部已展开独立调查。

title.zh: 皮尔逊机场黄金大劫案审讯：关键证人称记不清
title.en: Pearson gold heist trial: key witness says he can't recall much

summary.en: Former Air Canada employee Parmpal Sidhu is on trial in Brampton over the 2023 theft of 6,600 gold bars from Pearson airport, and has pleaded not guilty. The Crown calls him an inside man. Key witness Arsalan Chaudhary, already serving four years, testified he told Sidhu the truck was ready, but said he couldn't recall many other conversations.
summary.zh: 前加航员工西杜因2023年皮尔逊机场6600根金条被盗案在布兰普顿受审，他否认指控，检方称他是“内应”。已在服刑四年的关键证人乔杜里作证说，他曾告诉西杜卡车已就位，但表示记不清其他许多对话。

title.zh: 警队腐败案：一名多伦多警员获有条件释放
title.en: Toronto officer gets conditional discharge in Project South case

summary.en: Toronto police Const. Elias Mouawad received a conditional discharge, one year of probation and 100 hours of community service after pleading guilty to running an illegal licence plate search, part of the Project South police corruption probe. He won't have a criminal record if he meets the conditions. The Crown had asked for four months of house arrest and curfew.
summary.zh: 多伦多警员穆瓦德承认非法查询车牌，在“南方计划”警队腐败调查中被判有条件释放，缓刑一年并做100小时社区服务。如遵守条件，他将不会留下刑事记录。检方原本要求判处四个月软禁和宵禁。

title.zh: 加拿大
title.en: Canada

title.zh: 加拿大9月通胀升至3.1%，汽油涨近28%
title.en: Canada's inflation rises to 3.1% as gas prices jump 28%

summary.en: Statistics Canada says inflation rose to 3.1 per cent in September from 3.0 per cent, driven by gasoline, up 27.8 per cent from a year ago. Excluding gas, prices rose just 2.2 per cent, and grocery price growth slowed to 1.7 per cent. The Bank of Canada makes its next rate decision on October 28.
summary.zh: 加拿大统计局公布，9月通胀率从3.0%升至3.1%，主要受汽油价格同比上涨27.8%推动。剔除汽油后物价仅上涨2.2%，食品杂货涨幅放缓至1.7%。加拿大央行将于10月28日公布下一次利率决定。

title.zh: 市场押注央行下周加息，楼市“跪地不起”
title.en: Markets bet on a Bank of Canada rate hike as housing slumps

summary.en: Traders now put the odds of a quarter-point Bank of Canada rate hike next week at 87 per cent, CBC reports, which would push the rate up from 2.25 per cent. Scotiabank's Derek Holt backs a hike but calls it not a slam dunk, while RBC expects a hold. A hike would mean higher costs for variable-rate mortgages in an already weak housing market.
summary.zh: 据CBC报道，交易员目前认为加拿大央行下周加息0.25个百分点的概率达87%，利率将从2.25%上调。丰业银行的霍尔特支持加息但称“并非十拿九稳”，加拿大皇家银行则预计维持不变。一旦加息，浮动利率房贷成本将上升，令本已疲软的楼市雪上加霜。

title.zh: 专家警告今冬超市食品可能更贵
title.en: Experts warn of a tough winter at the grocery store

summary.en: Food experts and economists warn Canadians could face a tough winter at the grocery store, CTV News reports. Grocery inflation slowed to 1.7 per cent in September, the smallest rise since May 2024, but grocery prices are still about 33 per cent higher than in September 2020, and high fuel costs add pressure on food transport.
summary.zh: 据CTV报道，食品专家和经济学家警告，今年冬天加拿大人在超市可能会更吃力。9月食品杂货价格涨幅放缓至1.7%，是2024年5月以来最小，但价格仍比2020年9月高出约33%，而高油价也在推高食品运输成本。

title.zh: 联邦政府宣布11月5日公布新预算
title.en: Ottawa will table its federal budget on November 5

summary.en: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne announced in question period on Tuesday that the government will table its next budget on November 5. It comes as Canadians face rising gas prices, a possible interest rate hike and a trade war with the U.S. Separately, CBC reports Ottawa still has no launch date for its proposed sovereign wealth fund.
summary.zh: 财政部长商鹏飞周二在质询时间宣布，政府将于11月5日公布新一份预算。目前加拿大人正面临油价上涨、可能加息以及与美国的贸易战。另据CBC报道，联邦政府提出的主权财富基金仍没有确定启动日期。

title.zh: 特朗普收回对庞巴迪飞机的禁售威胁
title.en: Trump drops threat to ban Bombardier jets from the U.S.

summary.en: President Donald Trump said in Kansas on Tuesday that he won't hurt Canadian jet maker Bombardier, dropping a threat to ban its planes from the U.S. market. He credited a call from Kansas Senator Roger Marshall; Bombardier employs about 1,500 people in Wichita. Its shares rose 4 per cent, but the wider Canada-U.S. trade fight continues.
summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普周二在堪萨斯州表示不会伤害加拿大飞机制造商庞巴迪，收回了禁止其飞机进入美国市场的威胁。他说是堪萨斯州参议员马歇尔的电话让他改变主意，庞巴迪在威奇托雇有约1500人。庞巴迪股价上涨4%，但美加贸易争端仍在持续。

title.zh: Stelco大裁员，安省拨款助汉密尔顿应对关税冲击
title.en: Hundreds of Stelco layoffs as Ontario funds Hamilton tariff team

summary.en: Ontario is giving Hamilton $390,000 to set up a tariff response team as hundreds of layoffs hit steelmaker Stelco. Industry Minister Mélanie Joly said Ottawa took good note of comments by Stelco's U.S. owner, Cleveland-Cliffs, on its earnings call, and options include forcing a sale of Stelco or financial penalties.
summary.zh: 钢铁企业Stelco裁员数百人，安省拨款39万加元，帮助汉密尔顿成立关税应对小组。工业部长乔利表示，联邦政府已“注意到”Stelco美国母公司克利夫兰-克里夫斯在财报电话会上的言论，可选措施包括强制出售Stelco或经济处罚。

title.zh: 艾伯塔公投约76%选民支持留在加拿大
title.en: Albertans vote about 76% to stay in Canada

summary.en: Early results from Alberta's non-binding referendum show about 76 per cent of voters chose to stay in Canada. Prime Minister Mark Carney called it a clear choice for unity. In a TV address, Premier Danielle Smith said she now considers separation a dead issue for as long as she leads the province.
summary.zh: 艾伯塔省不具约束力的公投初步结果显示，约76%的选民选择留在加拿大。总理卡尼称这是“明确的团结选择”。省长史密斯在电视讲话中表示，只要她还担任省长，分离问题就已“翻篇”。

title.zh: 温赖特基地大火致4名军人遇难，全国哀悼
title.en: Canada mourns four soldiers killed in CFB Wainwright fire

summary.en: A fast-moving grass fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta killed four soldiers and injured 39, at least 19 critically, after the wind shifted during training. The four were preparing to deploy to Latvia next year. Prime Minister Carney ordered flags lowered, and the military and RCMP are investigating; a vigil is planned in Wainwright.
summary.zh: 艾伯塔省温赖特军事基地训练时风向突变，草原大火造成4名军人死亡、39人受伤，其中至少19人伤势危重。遇难者原本准备明年部署到拉脱维亚。总理卡尼下令降半旗，军方和皇家骑警正在调查，温赖特将举行悼念活动。

title.zh: 联邦枪支分类审查迟迟未启动，SKS步枪仍未禁
title.en: Federal gun review group, including SKS, has yet to meet

summary.en: Almost a year after Ottawa announced a review of firearms classification, including the SKS rifle, its technical advisory group still hasn't met; Public Safety Canada says it will meet later this fall. The SKS remains legal. Gun-control group PolySeSouvient wants an immediate ban on new SKS sales, with an exemption for Indigenous hunters.
summary.zh: 联邦政府宣布审查枪支分类（包括SKS步枪）已近一年，但其技术咨询小组至今尚未开会，公共安全部称将于今秋晚些时候召开。SKS目前仍属合法。控枪团体PolySeSouvient要求立即禁止新售SKS，原住民猎人可获豁免。

title.zh: 魁北克新总理宣誓就职，副总督应请求缺席
title.en: Quebec's new cabinet sworn in without the lieutenant-governor

summary.en: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is being sworn in as Quebec's premier, and at his request Lieutenant-Governor Manon Jeannotte is skipping the cabinet ceremony, a first. His party wants to abolish the monarchy in Quebec and the office of lieutenant-governor. Members elected October 5 swore allegiance only to the people of Quebec, not King Charles, a move being challenged in court.
summary.zh: 圣皮埃尔·普拉蒙东宣誓就任魁北克省总理，应他的要求，副总督雅诺特首次缺席内阁宣誓仪式。他的政党主张在魁北克废除君主制和副总督一职。10月5日当选的议员只向魁北克人民而非查尔斯国王宣誓效忠，此举正在法庭受到挑战。

title.zh: 绿党的弗莱击败肯·森，当选温哥华市长
title.en: Green's Pete Fry unseats Ken Sim as Vancouver mayor

summary.en: Green candidate Pete Fry defeated incumbent Ken Sim in B.C.'s October 17 municipal elections, becoming the first Green mayor of a major Canadian city. Voters in Vancouver, Surrey and other big B.C. cities opted for change, and many incumbents lost. Fry will lead a council dominated by three progressive parties.
summary.zh: 在10月17日的卑诗省市政选举中，绿党候选人弗莱击败现任市长肯·森，成为加拿大主要城市首位绿党市长。温哥华、素里等卑诗大城市选民纷纷求变，多位现任市长落选。弗莱将领导一个以三个进步派政党为主的市议会。

title.zh: 卡尔加里公交车相撞起火3死，警方寻找离场乘客
title.en: Calgary police seek passengers after fiery bus crash kills three

summary.en: Three people died and 16 were hurt when one Calgary transit bus struck another in the city's northeast on October 15, setting off an explosion and fire on the natural-gas-powered bus. Police say it's too early to know whether speed, impairment or distraction played a role, and they're asking passengers who left the scene to come forward.
summary.zh: 10月15日，卡尔加里东北部一辆公交车撞上另一辆以天然气为动力的公交车，引发爆炸起火，造成3人死亡、16人受伤。警方表示现在判断是否涉及超速、酒驾或分心驾驶还为时过早，并呼吁离开现场的乘客主动联系警方。

title.zh: 检方撤销对两名前安省警员暴力执法案的指控
title.en: Crown drops charges against two ex-OPP officers over 2022 arrest

summary.en: The Crown has withdrawn all criminal charges against former OPP officers Scott Anthony and Ethan Meyer over a violent 2022 arrest at a MacTier railyard that was caught on video. Richard Darren Morgan, the man arrested, had launched a private prosecution alleging assault and fabricated evidence. He has publicly criticized the decision; the Crown's reasons weren't given.
summary.zh: 检方撤销了对前安省警员安东尼和迈耶的全部刑事指控，此案涉及2022年在麦克蒂尔铁路场的一次被录像拍下的暴力逮捕。被捕者摩根曾提起私人检控，指控两人施暴和伪造证据。他公开批评撤诉决定，检方未说明理由。

title.zh: 考伊琴原住民土地案：多方申请暂缓执行裁决
title.en: Cowichan title appeal: parties seek to pause parts of the ruling

summary.en: B.C., Ottawa, the Port of Vancouver, the City of Richmond and two First Nations are asking the B.C. Court of Appeal to freeze parts of the landmark Cowichan Aboriginal title ruling, warning of chaos for private property, dikes, the port and fishing rights. Hearings are set for January; Richmond wants to keep maintaining its flood protection in the meantime.
summary.zh: 卑诗省、联邦政府、温哥华港、里士满市和两个原住民族群向卑诗上诉法院申请冻结考伊琴原住民土地所有权里程碑裁决的部分内容，警告这将给私人财产、堤坝、港口和捕鱼权带来混乱。听证定于1月举行，里士满希望在此期间继续维护防洪设施。

title.zh: 美国
title.en: United States

title.zh: 美股收盘：3M财报带动道指大涨530点
title.en: Wall Street close: Dow jumps 530 points on 3M earnings

summary.en: U.S. stocks closed mixed on Tuesday. The Dow rose about 530 points, or 1 per cent, to 52,495.88, and the S&P 500 gained 0.28 per cent to 7,712.57, while the Nasdaq was flat at 26,424.82 as big tech lagged. 3M jumped roughly 5 per cent after beating estimates and raising its full-year outlook.
summary.zh: 美股周二收盘涨跌互现。道指上涨约530点（1%），收于52,495.88点；标普500上涨0.28%，收于7,712.57点；纳斯达克持平于26,424.82点，大型科技股拖累。3M业绩超预期并上调全年展望，股价上涨约5%。

title.zh: 美国进口商起诉特朗普，挑战对加拿大商品50%关税
title.en: U.S. importer sues Trump over 50% tariffs on Canadian goods

summary.en: New Jersey food importer Gellert Global Group, which brings in Canadian cheese, sued the Trump administration on Tuesday in the U.S. Court of International Trade. It argues a rarely used 1930 law doesn't allow the 50 per cent tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods, which it says cost it about $40 million a year. It wants the tariffs stopped and refunds for importers.
summary.zh: 进口加拿大奶酪的新泽西食品进口商Gellert Global周二在美国国际贸易法院起诉特朗普政府，认为一部罕用的1930年法律并不授权对200亿美元加拿大商品征收50%关税。该公司称关税每年让其多付约4000万美元，要求停止征收并向进口商退款。

title.zh: 伊朗袭击霍尔木兹油轮，布伦特原油升破110美元
title.en: Brent crude tops $110 as Iran hits tankers in Hormuz

summary.en: Oil climbed to its highest level in about five months, with Brent touching $111.99 a barrel before settling near $109, after Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. One report counts at least 18 ships attacked in two weeks. Pakistan and Qatar are mediating, but no deal appears close, which keeps pressure on prices at the pump.
summary.zh: 由于伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡袭击油轮，油价升至约五个月高位，布伦特原油盘中触及每桶111.99美元，收于约109美元。有报道称两周内至少18艘船遇袭。巴基斯坦和卡塔尔正在斡旋，但协议似乎遥遥无期，加油站油价压力持续。

title.zh: 美国汽油均价略降至4.28美元，仍创超4美元天数纪录
title.en: U.S. gas dips to about $4.28 but stays above $4 for record stretch

summary.en: The U.S. national average for regular gas slipped about six cents in a week to around $4.28 a gallon, according to AAA data, but it's nearly a dollar higher than a year ago. Prices have stayed above $4 for a record number of days this year, and analysts warn crude back above $100 could push them up again.
summary.zh: 根据美国汽车协会数据，美国普通汽油全国均价一周下降约6美分，至每加仑约4.28美元，但仍比去年同期高出近1美元。今年油价高于4美元的天数已创纪录，分析人士警告，原油重回100美元以上可能再次推高油价。

title.zh: 中期选举前两周，特朗普赴北卡为惠特利助选
title.en: Two weeks before midterms, Trump rallies in North Carolina

summary.en: With the November 3 midterms two weeks away, President Trump rallied in Greenville, North Carolina, for Republican Senate candidate Michael Whatley, who trails former Democratic governor Roy Cooper in recent polls. Trump attacked Cooper's record and said he is working like a dog to keep the Republican House majority.
summary.zh: 距11月3日中期选举还有两周，特朗普在北卡罗来纳州格林维尔为共和党参议员候选人惠特利助选。惠特利在近期民调中落后于前民主党州长库珀。特朗普抨击库珀的政绩，并说自己正“拼命工作”以保住共和党在众议院的多数。

title.zh: 特朗普承诺发5000美元支票，连支持者也怀疑
title.en: Even Trump fans doubt his promised $5,000 checks

summary.en: Trump keeps promising every adult American a $5,000 'dividend' if Republicans hold Congress, but hasn't said how it would be paid for. The Tax Foundation says tariff revenue can't cover the cost, and a YouGov poll found only 21 per cent of voters believe the checks will come. Similar earlier promises never materialized.
summary.zh: 特朗普不断承诺，如果共和党保住国会，每位美国成年人将获得5000美元“红利”，但未说明资金来源。税务基金会称关税收入不足以支付，YouGov民调显示只有21%的选民相信支票会到手。此前类似承诺都未兑现。

title.zh: 库克政治报告调整选情评级，民主党略占上风
title.en: Cook Political Report shifts Senate races as Democrats gain

summary.en: The Cook Political Report moved Senate races in South Carolina and Mississippi toward Democrats and Minnesota toward Republicans on Tuesday, after shifting 11 House races toward Democrats last week. It projects Democrats gaining nine to 19 House seats, citing frustration with the economy, Trump's weak polling and the Iran war.
summary.zh: 库克政治报告周二把南卡罗来纳和密西西比的参议院选情向民主党调整，明尼苏达则向共和党倾斜；上周它已把11个众议院选区向民主党调整。该机构预测民主党将在众议院净增9至19席，原因包括选民对经济不满、特朗普支持率低迷和伊朗战争。

title.zh: 特朗普豁免对俄制裁，两党同声批评
title.en: Trump's Russia sanctions waiver draws bipartisan backlash

summary.en: Trump signed an order late Friday waiving sanctions and 500 per cent tariffs on Russia under a law set to take effect days later, saying it serves U.S. interests. Republican Senator Thom Tillis called it beyond irresponsible, and Democrat Chuck Schumer called it a deal with the devil. Ukraine's Zelensky condemned it; Russia praised it.
summary.zh: 特朗普上周五深夜签署命令，豁免一项即将生效的法律中对俄罗斯的制裁和500%关税，称此举符合美国利益。共和党参议员蒂利斯称其“极其不负责任”，民主党领袖舒默称之为“与魔鬼的交易”。乌克兰总统泽连斯基予以谴责，俄方则表示赞赏。

title.zh: 奈飞盈利超预期，但营收指引令股价下跌
title.en: Netflix beats on profit, but weak outlook sinks shares

summary.en: Netflix earned 87 cents a share in the third quarter, beating forecasts, on revenue of about $12.87 billion. But its fourth-quarter revenue outlook fell short and it cut its annual ad revenue target by $300 million, sending shares down about 4 to 6 per cent after hours. The stock is down about 25 per cent this year.
summary.zh: 奈飞第三季度每股盈利0.87美元，超出预期，营收约128.7亿美元。但第四季度营收预测低于预期，并把全年广告收入目标下调3亿美元，股价盘后下跌约4%至6%。奈飞股价今年以来已累计下跌约25%。

title.zh: 万斯拒绝为内塔尼亚胡连任背书，与特朗普分歧
title.en: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu, breaking with Trump

summary.en: Vice President JD Vance declined to back Benjamin Netanyahu's re-election, a day after President Trump gave the Israeli leader his complete and total support. Vance said he endorses American candidates and is focused on the midterms. Israel votes on October 27, and outlets called it a rare split between the two.
summary.zh: 特朗普对以色列总理内塔尼亚胡表示“全力支持”的第二天，副总统万斯拒绝为其连任背书，称自己只为美国候选人站台，目前专注于中期选举。以色列将于10月27日大选，媒体称这是两人罕见的分歧。

title.zh: 法国骚乱成为特朗普中期选举新话题
title.en: France's riots become a Trump midterm talking point

summary.en: Trump is using footage of rioting in France at his rallies, calling it a warning of what could happen if Democrats win and blaming immigration. CNN reports there's little evidence immigrants drove the violence, which began as a student protest over school funding and grew over living costs and fuel prices. Fox News reports about 2,400 arrests.
summary.zh: 特朗普在集会上播放法国骚乱画面，称这是民主党获胜后可能出现的情况，并归咎于移民。CNN指出几乎没有证据显示暴力由移民引发，抗议起初是学生争取学校经费，后因生活成本和油价扩大。福克斯新闻报道约2400人被捕。

title.zh: 特朗普称华盛顿高尔夫球场为“垃圾岛”，与法官交锋
title.en: Trump calls D.C. golf course 'Trash Island' after court hearing

summary.en: A federal judge ordered the government to give three days' notice before making irreversible changes to East Potomac Golf Links, which Trump wants to close and renovate. After the hearing, Trump posted photos of debris and flooding, calling the course Trash Island and the judge insane. One report says the site was used to dump debris from the White House East Wing demolition.
summary.zh: 特朗普计划关闭并翻新华盛顿东波托马克高尔夫球场，联邦法官命令政府在作出不可逆改动前须提前三天通知。听证会后，特朗普发布垃圾和积水照片，称球场为“垃圾岛”，并称法官“疯了”。有报道称该地曾被用来倾倒白宫东翼拆除的废料。

title.zh: 体育
title.en: Sports

title.zh: 枫叶客场6-2大胜蓝衫军，马修斯出战第700场
title.en: Maple Leafs rout Blue Jackets 6-2 in Matthews' 700th game

summary.en: The Maple Leafs beat the Blue Jackets 6-2 in Columbus on Tuesday, scoring four straight goals in the second period. Easton Cowan and Jack Roslovic each had a goal and two assists, Anthony Stolarz made 33 saves, and Auston Matthews played his 700th NHL game. It's Toronto's second win in two nights, after a 3-1 victory over San Jose.
summary.zh: 枫叶周二客场6比2击败哥伦布蓝衫军，第二节连进四球。考恩和罗斯拉维奇各得1球2助攻，斯托拉兹扑出33球，马修斯迎来NHL第700场比赛。这是枫叶连续两晚取胜，前一晚以3比1击败圣何塞鲨鱼。

title.zh: 猛龙今晚主场迎战公牛，揭开新赛季
title.en: Raptors open their season at home against the Bulls tonight

summary.en: The Raptors start their 2026-27 regular season tonight at home against the Chicago Bulls, with tip-off at 7:30 p.m. Toronto is favoured by 9.5 points. The Raptors lost their preseason games against Miami and New York, so tonight is a first chance to set the tone.
summary.zh: 猛龙今晚在主场迎战芝加哥公牛，揭开2026至27赛季常规赛，晚上7点半开打，猛龙被看好让9.5分。猛龙季前赛先后输给迈阿密热火和纽约尼克斯，今晚是新赛季定调的第一战。

title.zh: NBA开幕夜：活塞逆转凯尔特人，詹姆斯76人首秀告捷
title.en: NBA opening night: Pistons rally past Celtics, LeBron's 76ers win

summary.en: The NBA season opened Tuesday with Detroit erasing a 22-point deficit, including a 23-0 run, to beat Boston 121-113. Philadelphia won 106-100 at Madison Square Garden on the Knicks' banner night, with Tyrese Maxey scoring 28 and LeBron James posting 14 points, nine rebounds and seven assists in his 76ers debut.
summary.zh: NBA新赛季周二开幕，活塞一度落后22分，打出23比0攻势后以121比113逆转凯尔特人。76人在尼克斯升冠军旗之夜以106比100客胜，马克西得到28分，詹姆斯在76人首秀中贡献14分9篮板7助攻。

title.zh: NFL：49人队23-17险胜突击者，保持全胜
title.en: 49ers hold off Commanders 23-17 to stay unbeaten

summary.en: The San Francisco 49ers beat the Washington Commanders 23-17 on Monday Night Football to improve to 6-0. Christian McCaffrey ran in two touchdowns as San Francisco led 20-3 at half-time, then held off a Jayden Daniels-led comeback. Receiver Mike Evans left with an Achilles injury.
summary.zh: 周一晚间橄榄球赛中，旧金山49人队以23比17击败华盛顿突击者，战绩提升至6胜0负。麦卡弗里两次冲球达阵，49人队半场以20比3领先，随后顶住丹尼尔斯带领的反扑。外接手埃文斯跟腱受伤离场。

title.zh: 世界大赛周五开打：光芒对酿酒人，都在追首冠
title.en: World Series starts Friday: Rays vs. Brewers, both chasing a first title

summary.en: The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers meet in the World Series, starting Friday at 8 p.m. Eastern in Milwaukee. The Brewers swept the Dodgers for their first National League pennant, and the Rays beat Cleveland in six games. It's the first World Series since 1980 between two teams that have never won it.
summary.zh: 坦帕湾光芒与密尔沃基酿酒人将在世界大赛相遇，首战周五晚8点（东部时间）在密尔沃基开打。酿酒人横扫道奇，首夺国联冠军；光芒六场击败克利夫兰。这是1980年以来首次由两支从未夺冠的球队争夺世界大赛冠军。

title.zh: 欧冠：巴黎4-2击败巴萨，对手赛季首败
title.en: PSG beat Barcelona 4-2 in a Champions League classic

summary.en: Paris Saint-Germain beat Barcelona 4-2 in Paris on Tuesday, handing Hansi Flick's side its first loss of the season. Lamine Yamal levelled at 2-2 before Vitinha and Fabián Ruiz scored late. The win puts PSG level with Liverpool atop the league phase on nine points.
summary.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼周二在主场4比2击败巴塞罗那，让弗里克的球队吞下本赛季首败。亚马尔一度把比分扳成2比2，维蒂尼亚和法维安·鲁伊斯随后在比赛后段进球。巴黎以9分与利物浦并列联赛阶段榜首。

title.zh: 欧冠：利物浦先丢两球后4-3逆转比利亚雷亚尔
title.en: Liverpool come from 2-0 down to beat Villarreal 4-3

summary.en: Liverpool fell 2-0 behind inside 30 minutes at Anfield on Tuesday but beat Villarreal 4-3. Alexis Mac Allister scored twice and Florian Wirtz added the fourth, while 18-year-old Rio Ngumoha set up two goals. Liverpool share top spot with PSG on nine points.
summary.zh: 利物浦周二在安菲尔德开场30分钟内0比2落后，最终4比3逆转比利亚雷亚尔。麦卡利斯特梅开二度，维尔茨打进第四球，18岁的恩古莫哈送出两次助攻。利物浦以9分与巴黎并列榜首。

title.zh: 英超：马杜埃凯绝杀，阿森纳1-0客胜森林
title.en: Madueke's late goal gives Arsenal 1-0 win at Forest

summary.en: Substitute Noni Madueke scored in the 80th minute as Arsenal won 1-0 at Nottingham Forest on Sunday, despite managing just one shot on target. The win keeps Arsenal three points behind Premier League leaders Manchester City, while Forest drop into the relegation zone.
summary.zh: 阿森纳周日1比0客胜诺丁汉森林，替补上场的马杜埃凯第80分钟打进制胜球，这也是阿森纳全场唯一一次射正。枪手仍落后英超榜首曼城3分，森林则跌入降级区。
